{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Heya. was making with the plunder this morning on thaere's old holonet nodes and found this. kinda thought everyone might wanna see it; went ahead and sliced the encryption for y'all too.|Tiny.f, sharing on a Cularin holonet node forum a decrypted Thaereian military communication.|<ref name="destabilization">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040105|text=Destabilization}}</ref>}}
The '''Cularin holonet node''' was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] node in operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Cularin holonet services hereby suspends this forum until further notice.|holosrv, announcing the suspension of a Cularin holonet node form by Cularin holonet services|<ref name="destabilization" />}}
The Cularin holonet node was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] node associated with the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] which featured a forum on which users could post messages. Posts on the holonet node recorded the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the post and the user ID and node location of the poster. The organization [[Cularin holonet services]] had a role in the administration of the node.<ref name="destabilization" />

==History==
{{Quote|Hey. I held on to this for about two days, trying to figure out what to do with it. I was practicing decrypting and snagged this in transit from Almas to Coruscant. The encryption was good. Pretty snarled, in a standard kind of way. Not much of a thing to slice it.|mstrslcr, posting on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="academic review">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041007|text=Academic Review}}</ref>}}
The holonet node was in operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around the time of [[Operation False Horizon]], the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Tiny.f]] shared on a Cularin holonet node forum a decrypted message ostensibly obtained from a [[Thaereian military]] source that referenced a [[Thaereian]] plot to destabilize the Cularin system. A number of users posted replies that discussed the legitimacy of the evidence shared by Tiny.f and the implications of the supposed Thaereian scheme. The following [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Cularin holonet services intervened to close the forum and the user "[[holosrv]]" posted on the thread on their behalf to warn that the material circulated by Tiny.f potentially violated security rules and any individuals who continued to discuss it would be detained.<ref name="destabilization" />

A male [[Tarasin]] using the moniker "[[native4all]]" later posted on the node to describe [[Gender/Legends|his]] experiences during the [[Tarasin Revolt]],<ref name="Cularin">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040520|text=Jungle Warfare}}</ref> a conflict fought many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] between the native Tarasin and off-world corporations.<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Around this time, the user "[[mstrslcr]]" distributed on the Cularin holonet node an intercepted a report from an unspecified party transmitted from the<ref name="academic review" /> planet<ref name="LFCG" /> [[Almas]] to the<ref name="academic review" /> [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|coruscant|Coruscant}}</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] which appeared to call for intervention in the operation of Almas' [[Almas Academy|Jedi academy]]. The contents of the message were widely debated and several users suggested that it was a hoax&mdash;the poster "[[tharestinx]]" speculated that the message was part of a plot by the Thaereian military,  while the user "[[puesso]]" highlighted similarities in the syntax used in the report with [[Metatheran Cartel]] [[Writing/Legends|written]] documents. Cularin holonet services subsequently suspended the forum on security grounds.<ref name="academic review" />

Following an unsuccessful request for aid by [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]], the Cularin system's [[Senator/Legends|senator]], to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], an article outlining her petition was circulated on Cularin's holonets.<ref name="zero zero zero">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041104|text=Zero Zero Zero}}</ref> On another occasion, an uncredited story was published on the Cularin holonet node in which a Thaereian military [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] called [[Nightwing]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] his superior [[Officer/Legends|officer]], [[Kulkis]]. Rumors soon emerged that the story was based on true events and was written by [[Osten Dal'Nay]], a former member of the Thaereian military involved with the [[Cularin Militia]].
<ref name="the best defense">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050310b|text=The Best Defense}}</ref> Various theories were advanced by users of the holonet regarding the story, some considering it to be genuine and identifying Dal'Nay as Nightwing, while the user "[[critsym]]" criticized the literary worth of the story.<ref name="everyone's a critic">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050331b|text=Everyone's a Critic}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Cularin holonet node was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Wizards.com]] article ''[[Destabilization (article)|Destabilization]]'', which was written by [[Morrie Mullins]] and published on [[May 1]], [[2004]] as a tie-in to [[RPGA]]'s ''[[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]]'' [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] campaign.<ref name="destabilization" /> The holonet node was subsequently referenced in several further ''Living Force'' Wizards.com articles released across 2004 and [[2005]].<ref name="academic review" /><ref name="the best defense" /><ref name="everyone's a critic" />
